summary.text: Steve Carra is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 36 who has held a seat in the Michigan House since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Steve Carra graduated from Portage Northern High School and earned degrees in economics and political science from Western Michigan University in 2011.
His career experience includes working as a research assistant with the Acton Institute.
Carra won the November 3, 2020 general election for Michigan House District 59, defeating Democrat Amy East, and his tenure began in 2021; he has represented District 36 since January 1, 2023.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, and in the 2025-2026 session sits on the House Oversight and Transportation committees.
